advice.yellow: Shorten outdoor play, move strenuous activity to the safest hours, and keep students with breathing problems indoors.
advice.red: Move PE and assembly indoors, keep windows closed, and avoid outdoor activity.
advice.unknown: There is not enough forecast data to classify this period.

activityGuidance.incomplete_forecast: Forecast readings are incomplete. Check local conditions and follow existing school policy; do not treat missing data as GREEN.
